verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a dedicated sandbox environment (demo.ramp.com / demo-api.ramp.com) explicitly for building and testing against the API 'without affecting live production data,' with no real money movement, simulation hooks via the demo actions panel, and both the CLI and MCP defaulting to or supporting sandbox/demo accounts. This is well-documented first-party evidence directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of sandbox fidelity or limitations beyond vendor docs.
